self_registration.what: Firsthand registered itself on the same identity registry it surveys, and indexed that registration into the same set.

method.note: Aggregate only. No agent or claimant is named, ranked or accused. This is a finding about the registry's design.

finding.reads: 16 of 22 subjects carrying feedback have exactly one party speaking about them. A layer that counts feedback cannot tell that apart from several parties agreeing.

standings.grounded_requires: 3 or more observations corroborated by a different party
standings.suspect_note: Zero. No agent in the indexed set has two conflicting owner records, and Firsthand does not publish a suspect standing it cannot point at.
